description: 🚨 DESTRUCTIVE — Remove broken `check:docs:mcp` script from package.json. File `scripts/check-mcp-docs-quality.mjs` confirmed missing (scripts/ has only tasks.mjs). Criteria: script no longer listed; `npm run build && npm test` still exit 0.

Add `notifyMemoryResourceUpdated(server, hash)` to store-memory.ts after successful insert (when `created === true`). Import from `./helpers.js`. Criteria: new memories emit resource update notification; duplicate stores (created=false) do not; existing tests still pass.

Add `notifyMemoryResourceUpdated` loop to store-memories.ts after the batch completes. Notify per item where `item.created === true`. Import from `./helpers.js`. Criteria: each newly stored memory in a batch emits its resource notification; tests pass.

Fix `IconDescriptor` interface in src/server.ts: change `mimeType` and `sizes` to optional (`?`), add `theme?: 'light' | 'dark'`. Criteria: interface matches MCP Icon spec; `npm run type-check` passes; runtime createIconDescriptors() still functions.

Make `ToolRegistrar` type explicit in src/tools/index.ts. Replace `type ToolRegistrar = typeof registerStoreMemory` with `type ToolRegistrar = (server: McpServer, db: TypedDb) => void`. Add McpServer + TypedDb imports. Criteria: type-check passes; removing any single registrar function would not break the type definition.

Extract shared instructions loader. Create src/lib/instructions.ts with `loadInstructions()`. Update src/resources/index.ts to import from lib/instructions.js. Update src/prompts/index.ts to load from lib/instructions.js instead of the hardcoded string literal. Criteria: `get-help` prompt and `internal://instructions` resource serve identical content; instructions.md changes flow to both; type-check + tests pass.

Document FTS tokenization behavior. In src/tools/search-memories.ts: append `Query terms are matched individually; FTS5 phrase operators and negation are not supported.` to the tool description. Same addition to recall.ts description. In src/instructions.md, update the search_memories Gotcha entry. Criteria: descriptions accurately reflect sanitizeFtsQuery behavior; no runtime change.

Replace `getOrderBy()` string function with typed `ORDER_BY_MAP` constant in src/tools/retrieve-context.ts. Use `satisfies Record<ContextStrategy, string>` to ensure type safety. Criteria: all three strategies produce identical SQL ORDER BY clauses as before; type-check passes; retrieve-context.test.ts passes.
Add `E_DB_ERROR` and `E_CONFLICT` constants to src/lib/errors.ts. Criteria: both constants are exported; all existing callers unaffected (no usages to update); type-check passes.
